macros.name: ClearPackageOptions
macros.doc: Clears the options that will be loaded into the macro package.

macros.name: SetOptionsToPackage
macros.doc: Passes options to the macro package, the location of the passed options is to the right of the options used when loading the macro package.

macros.name: SetOptionsToPackage*
macros.doc: Passes options to the macro package, the location of the passed options is to the right of the options used when loading the macro package.
